resources.string: This app is for Somali and East African people—a social marriage platform.

Never send money or share private identity details. Be cautious with links and requests to move off the app.
Safety reminder: this message may contain a link, contact information, or a money request.
Choose ages from 18 to 120, with minimum no greater than maximum.
Show my city (never a precise address)
Involvement is always your choice. An invitation allows introduction requests only. It never grants access to private conversations.
Share this code privately with someone you trust. It expires in 7 days. They must sign in and accept it.
Your email is verified. Phone, selfie and identity verification require their respective providers. Government-ID verification is currently unavailable; no identity badge has been issued.
Premium will offer unlimited interests, advanced discovery and additional compatibility insights. Safety, blocking, reporting and basic matched messaging remain free.
Subscriptions are not available until Google Play products and server purchase validation are configured. No purchase will be started.
Current plan: Free · 10 interests per day

Take your time. Never send money to someone you have only met online. Keep identity documents, financial information and your address private. Meet in public and tell someone you trust.\n\nYou may block, report or unmatch at any time. If you are in immediate danger, contact local emergency services.

Adults 18+ only. Be honest about your identity and intentions. Respect consent and boundaries. Harassment, impersonation, scams and inappropriate content are not allowed. Never pressure someone to involve family or share private information.
Your profile will be paused immediately and a deletion request recorded. Final data erasure requires the account-deletion service. This build does not claim immediate erasure.
This changes your account access. You may need to log in again before continuing.
This export contains account, profile, settings and subscription records. Conversation export is not included yet.
